resources.string: LottoDost is an independent app. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Government of Nagaland, the Government of Sikkim, the Government of Punjab or any lottery department. We do not sell tickets and never ask for money. Results are collected from public sources — always verify with the official result before claiming a prize. Buying lottery tickets is not allowed in every state. For adults (18+) only.
No app, agent or WhatsApp group can predict or fix lottery numbers. LottoDost never sells tickets and never asks for money, bank or UPI details. Treat any \"guaranteed number\" offer as fraud.

Nagaland prizes above ₹10,000 must be claimed within 30 days of the draw at the Directorate of Nagaland State Lotteries, Kohima, or its nodal offices, with the original ticket and 3 attested passport photos (as printed on the official result). Ask your ticket seller about smaller prizes. Tax is deducted on large prizes.
Prizes up to ₹10,000: ask the seller or stockist where you bought the ticket. Verify with the official result first.
For Sikkim and Punjab draws, follow the claim instructions printed on your ticket and on the official result. Ask your seller first.

39 = serial (34–99) · C = series letter (A B C D E G H J K L — never F or I) · 06366 = number.
• 1st Prize: the whole number must match.
• Consolation: same 5 digits as the 1st Prize, any other serial or letter.
• 2nd Prize: last 5 digits.
• 3rd, 4th and 5th Prizes: last 4 digits.
Dear Laxmi tickets (10–29 + 4 digits) win on the 4 digits. Bumper tickets (e.g. A 801021) have their own prize table — see the result.
Notify me when results are out

Fast results come from the Lottery Sambad result sheet minutes after each draw. When the government gazette is published, we compare them and mark a result Verified when its 1st and 2nd prize numbers match.

No account needed. Saved tickets stay on your phone. Ticket photos are read on your phone and are never uploaded by this app. Google Play services may collect basic diagnostics for the on-device text reader.
